entities.name: PMID:10735775
observations: Primary pig study tested bronchiolar epithelial bronchodilatory activity before and after 1.5 hours of normothermic cardiopulmonary bypass.
Approximately 100-µm bronchiolar segments were studied by videomicroscopy, with intact or denuded epithelium and 10 µM 5-hydroxytryptamine preconstriction.
Isoproterenol relaxation had an epithelium-dependent component; bronchodilator responses were not significantly different after versus before bypass.
Authors concluded that epithelium-dependent bronchodilatory activity was preserved after normothermic cardiopulmonary bypass.

entities.name: Preserved bronchodilation after CPB
observations: In pig bronchioles, normothermic cardiopulmonary bypass did not significantly alter epithelium-dependent isoproterenol bronchodilation measured after recovery from bypass.
Epithelial denudation reduced isoproterenol-induced relaxation, while nitroprusside relaxation was epithelium-independent.
